description: Compare supplied own and competitor pages to find missing topics, weak coverage, format gaps, and buyer-stage gaps. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

competitors.description: Competitor domains with their supplied page records; no competitor crawl is performed. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 10 items. Required.

items.description: One competitor domain with its supplied page records. Type: Object. Required.

domain.description: Website hostname associated with this record, for example example.com rather than a business name. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 160 characters. Required.

pages.description: Supplied page records to compare; URLs identify the records and are not instructions to publish changes. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 100 items. Required.

items.description: One supplied page record used in this comparison. Type: Object. Required.

avg_position.description: Supplied mean organic search position, where 1 is best; not an authority score. Type: Number. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Optional; no client default.

backlinks.description: Count of backlinks reported for this supplied page. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

buyer_stage.description: Buyer-journey stage associated with this page or opportunity. Type: String. Accepted values: "awareness", "consideration", "decision", "implementation", "retention". Default: "awareness".

description.description: Short summary of this supplied page; this is input evidence, not a request to generate a meta description. Type: String. Maximum: 500 characters. Optional; no client default.

estimated_traffic.description: Estimated search visits for this supplied page; use a consistent time window across compared pages. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

keywords.description: Search phrases to evaluate or associate with the supplied page. Type: Array. Maximum: 100 items. Default: [].

items.description: One search keyword or phrase, not a comma-separated list. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

page_type.description: Page format or classification for this record; select one of the accepted values. Type: String. Accepted values: "unknown", "homepage", "blog_post", "landing_page", "product", "software", "local_business", "comparison_page", "guide", "docs", "template", "tool", "case_study". Default: "unknown".

ranking_queries.description: Search queries known to rank for this page from your supplied evidence. Type: Array. Maximum: 100 items. Default: [].

items.description: One search query known to rank for this page. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

search_volume.description: Estimated monthly searches for this supplied keyword or topic, not a measured page-visit count. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 180 characters. Required.

url.description: Absolute URL identifying this supplied own or competitor page; all comparison evidence comes from the supplied record. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

focus_topics.description: Topics to prioritize in the supplied competitor content comparison. Type: Array. Maximum: 100 items. Default: [].

items.description: One topic to prioritize in the competitor comparison. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

max_opportunities.description: Maximum number of prioritized opportunities to return from the supplied comparison. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Default: 30.

own_pages.description: Your supplied page records for comparison with competitor pages; an empty list represents no supplied owned coverage. Type: Array. Maximum: 100 items. Default: [].
